parameters.query:
SELECT
  t.id AS task_id,
  t.title AS task_title,
  t.status,
  t.priority,
  t.story_points,
  t.due_date,
  t.is_bottleneck,
  t.project_id,
  t.assignee_id,
  t.created_at,
  t.updated_at,
  m.full_name AS assignee_name,
  m.email AS assignee_email,
  p.name AS project_name,
  p.deadline AS project_deadline
FROM tasks t
LEFT JOIN members m ON t.assignee_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.id
WHERE t.id = '{{ $('Code - Validate Input').first().json.body.task_id }}';

INSERT INTO task_logs (task_id, changed_by, old_status, new_status, comment)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Code - Validate Input').first().json.body.task_id }}',
  {{ $('Code - Validate Input').first().json.body.changed_by ? "'" + $('Code - Validate Input').first().json.body.changed_by + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $('Code - Validate Input').first().json.body.old_status }}',
  '{{ $('Code - Validate Input').first().json.body.new_status }}',
  'Logged by n8n Flow 5 (Advanced)'
)
RETURNING *;

UPDATE tasks
SET is_bottleneck = FALSE,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = '{{ $('Code - Calculate Lead Time & Metrics').first().json.task_id }}'
  AND is_bottleneck = TRUE
RETURNING id, title, is_bottleneck;

UPDATE members
SET productivity_score = LEAST(200.00, productivity_score +
  CASE
    WHEN '{{ $('Code - Calculate Lead Time & Metrics').first().json.priority }}' = 'URGENT' THEN 5.0
    WHEN '{{ $('Code - Calculate Lead Time & Metrics').first().json.priority }}' = 'HIGH' THEN 3.0
    WHEN '{{ $('Code - Calculate Lead Time & Metrics').first().json.priority }}' = 'MEDIUM' THEN 2.0
    ELSE 1.0
  END *
  CASE
    WHEN {{ $('Code - Calculate Lead Time & Metrics').first().json.is_overdue }} = true THEN 0.5
    ELSE 1.0
  END
)
WHERE id = {{ $('Code - Calculate Lead Time & Metrics').first().json.assignee_id ? "'" + $('Code - Calculate Lead Time & Metrics').first().json.assignee_id + "'" : 'NULL' }}
RETURNING id, full_name, productivity_score;
